purpose: dual-range strain sweep 1mN to 50N grip without saturation
code_or_query:
import numpy as np
p_light=5.78 # kPa at 1mN
# assume pressure scales ~ F^(1/3) Hertz: p ~ F^(1/3)
F=np.array([0.001,0.01,0.1,1.0,2.0,10.0,50.0])
p=p_light*(F/0.001)**(1/3)
E=435.0 # kPa dielectric modulus
strain=p/E
print([round(float(x),4) for x in p], [round(float(x),4) for x in strain])
